item.title: Billionaire Frank Stronach’s sex assault trial delayed as defence deals with new info
item.description: The sexual assault trial of billionaire Frank Stronach was delayed Tuesday as his lawyer requested more time to handle an influx of materials.

item.title: Vancouver home sales continue sluggish pace to kick of 2026: real estate board
item.description: Real estate activity in the Vancouver area got off to a slow start this year as residential sales in the region totalled 1,107 last month, down 28.7%.
